assertion_audit: tests/test_bank_newton_step.py:322 fails if the step update differs from NumPy's independently solved three-block linear system; the sign-reversal mutation makes it fail.
tests/test_bank_newton_step.py:323 fails if the returned linear residual reaches 1e-12; it is an independent fixed threshold but uses the step's reported residual.
tests/test_bank_newton_step.py:324 fails if equilibration does not lower condition number; both operands are returned by the step, so it does not establish an externally measured condition number.
tests/test_bank_newton_step.py:325 fails if the step reports non-convergence on this known accurate linear solve; it follows the same returned residual as line 323.
tests/test_bank_newton_step.py:329 fails if a small fresh and tracked residual with valid read is rejected.

tests/test_bank_newton_step.py:330-332 fail if an oversized fresh residual, invalid read, or nonfinite fresh residual is accepted; the H200 receipt also observes an oversized fresh residual at the call site.
No new assertion compares the result to an expected value that was itself supplied to the code under test; the NumPy solve at line 321 uses the fixture values but computes an independent answer.

findings.text: A fresh read returns residual 0.0303684 after the tracked solve reaches 8.53e-13; the 1e-10 convergence, 0.5 ms wall, converged JVP, launch-count and cold-compile gates remain unmet.
The added factor reference differentiates the bank step residual itself and never reaches the production forward route, so it cannot establish the required same-iterate route-update agreement.
The relative factor difference and reference-finite flag are only emitted; no threshold or finite assertion fails the measurement when the comparison regresses.

findings.disposition_reason: The H200 factor receipts and step sign-mutation supply the relevant current evidence.
findings.text: The parent-source probe uses the historical --compare-present flag while the delivered measurement uses --compare-dense-factor, so that probe does not exercise the final comparison flag.
